description: FFmpegKit / ffmpeg-kit, actively maintained. Drop-in replacement for com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-audio (Arthenica's fork, retired April 2025) -- same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, just change the groupId. Audio codecs: lame, libilbc, libvorbis, opencore-amr, opus, shine, soxr, speex, twolame, vo-amrwbenc. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
